text:
Leah (CS): quick account health check for NimbusPay — onboarding wk3. Prod traffic ~12k req/day. p50 text-gen ~180ms, p95 ~890ms, unit cost trending up (est $0.022/token) esp on long prompts. noticing error spikes on >1k token responses. thinking we should preemptively optimize before renewal convo. suggestions below

Devon (SE): +1 on preempt. do we have a perf profile per route? can you drop the recent k6 run?

Leah (CS): I attached the high-level numbers from last 72h (summarized). sending k6 later today. biggest slack is p95 tail on /chat/complete when users ask for long docs.

Mira (Applied ML): quick read — two low-friction levers: 1) enable compact fallback (redwood-lite-7b) for responses >800 tokens, 2) apply an int8 quant profile on their current model (q8->int8 path) and run regen checks. Both reduce GPU time and cost. Also prefix KV caching for repeated prompts can cut token decoding by ~15%.

Tom (Solutions): routing idea: route by predicted output-length and latency SLO. policy: prefer full model for short/critical replies, switch to compact if predicted tokens >800 or when p95 exceeds 600ms. canary: 5% traffic for 48h, auto rollback on >2% regression in quality or >10% increase in error rate.

Aaron (Renewals): flagged — NimbusPay hits our renewal review next month. If we can show a 20–30% cost reduction and stable quality, renewal conversation becomes easier. we should aim for results before renewal deck.

Devon (SE): i can own the canary rollout. need the config we'll push and the eval harness for quality checks. Mira — can you provide sample eval prompt set and oracle thresholds?

Mira (Applied ML): yep. i'll produce a 200-prompt eval covering long-form, instruction-following, and safety edge-cases. acceptance: semantic-similarity >=0.92 (embeddings cosine) and no >1.5% uptick in hallucination flags per our internal detector.

Leah (CS): perfect. client enablement: i'll prepare a short note to NimbusPay explaining temporary fallback behavior and expected latency/cost benefits. want to avoid unexpected UX regressions.

Devon (SE): here's the rollout snippet i propose (feature flag + routing):

```json
{
  "route": "/chat/complete",
  "routing_policy": "predict-length",
  "predict_length_threshold": 800,
  "fallback_model": "redwood-lite-7b",
  "canary_fraction": 0.05,
  "canary_duration_hours": 48,
  "quality_gate": {
    "semantic_cosine_min": 0.92,
    "max_hallucination_increase_pct": 1.5
  }
}
```

Tom (Solutions): looks good. ops-bot — please create a canary run ticket and put the deploy window for today 1800-2000 PST.

ops-bot: created ticket CS-4821: "NimbusPay canary: compact-fallback + int8 profiling" — https://redwood.internal/tickets/CS-4821 :white_check_mark:

Leah (CS): can we get an estimate on engineering effort for int8 profile and quick regression tests?

Mira (Applied ML): int8 profiling: ~1 dev-day to run and validate on our harness, plus ~0.5 day to collect eval metrics. regression harness already exists — i can run it and share results within 24h.

Devon (SE): engineering to add routing hook + feature flag: ~1.5 dev-days. i'll pair with Mira for the eval automation.

Aaron (Renewals): timeline sounds great. Leah — once we have canary numbers, i'll draft the renewal deck section showing expected cost delta and risk mitigation steps.

Leah (CS): action items: 1) Mira produce eval set (24h) 2) Devon push canary config + routing (today) 3) ops-bot ticket in triage (done) 4) Leah prepare customer note and renewal blurb. i'll sync again after canary baseline. thanks team :thumbsup:
